title: stable rank-placement sort of 8 values (negatives, duplicates): ordering, multiplicity, count, sum, extremes

provenance.author: DRPLi E2E-50/P2 step 4 corpus
provenance.note: written for this project; independently specified; no third-party import; FS-01 2026-11-02 output-statement revision (see notes)

notes:
FS-01 REVISION (2026-11-02): OUTPUT STATEMENTS ONLY. The E2E-50/P2 source
(sha256 67f53bb8ea06f5605018d9b969ffb2004075954014d111924a10f336f430d8f2) printed the
sorted values on ONE long PUT LIST line and FAILed on framing: harness anchor residue
(F1, fixed in the harness by FS-01) plus DR PLILIB's measured 79-column print-wrap
(F2, spec/lab-evidence/e2e50-p2/step6/RESULTS.md section 2 - that FAIL evidence is
preserved, not rewritten). The revised program splits the sorted values into TWO short
labelled lines ('SORTED 1-4:' via put list, 'SORTED 5-8:' via put skip list), each ~54
columns raw and far inside the wrap; the rank-placement algorithm, the input values and
the checked invariants (ordering, multiplicity, sum, count, extremes) are UNCHANGED.
Expected lines are DERIVED from the declared output design plus the README section 6
format law (reference.py:table01), never from a capture (L3); PLILIB's wrap law is NOT
characterized or claimed here (FS-01 boundary). Reference sequence is Python's OWN
sorted multiset - the PL/I rank-placement algorithm is under test, never the reference.
The two duplicates (-3 twice, 7 twice) must both appear (multiplicity); SUM= 25 and
N= 8 over the sorted table prove no slot was overwritten or lost (rank collisions
would duplicate or drop an element). Nested indexed DO is the times-two composition of
the measured LOOP.DO_TO_BY shape. Scalar compares only (G114B-backed strict relations);
array-element compares (AB11/LR9 refusals), >=, <= (COND.GE_LE), literal-left
(COND.LITERAL_LEFT), multidim, K_PLUS_X and traversal reload are deliberately absent.
Original P2 compile-check: 1536-byte .REL (code=627 data=50); the revised program
re-compiles - actual sizes are recorded by the run evidence, not here.
